note: Starter vocabulary. Describes how the car is propelled and energised, not the engine's internal layout (a V8 and a flat-six are both 'petrol'; cylinder configuration lives on the trim's engine block).

terms.label: Petrol
terms.description: Spark-ignition internal combustion, no electric drive assistance.

terms.label: Mild hybrid
terms.description: Belt or integrated starter-generator that assists but cannot drive the car alone.

terms.label: Hybrid
terms.description: Full hybrid: can move under electric power alone, charged only by the car itself.

terms.label: Plug-in hybrid
terms.description: Full hybrid with a plug-chargeable battery and meaningful electric-only range.

terms.label: Range extender
terms.description: Electric drive throughout, with a combustion engine used only as a generator.

terms.label: Hydrogen fuel cell
terms.description: Electric drive fed by an onboard hydrogen fuel cell.

terms.label: LPG
terms.description: Liquefied petroleum gas, factory-fitted or homologated.

terms.label: CNG
terms.description: Compressed natural gas, factory-fitted or homologated.

terms.label: Rotary
terms.description: Wankel rotary combustion, tracked separately because its consumption and output characteristics do not model like a reciprocating petrol engine.
